descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le champ spécifique de l’infirmier∙ière de liaison couvre la clientèle imad (connue ou future clientèle) hospitalisée, nécessitant un retour à domicile avec des prestations imad. Son champ d’activité se décline notamment en termes d’évaluation des besoins, de validation médicale des prestations requises, de coordination prévisionnelle des interventions par les équipes de maintien à domicile (EMD) et/ou les services centralisés.
 Vos missions et responsabilités

• Informer les clients ou futurs clients des prestations domiciliaires offertes par imad, des partenaires du réseau socio-sanitaire genevois, des tarifs et des modalités de remboursement des prestations de maintien à domicile. Selon nécessité, orienter le client vers la personne ou la structure qui peut le conseiller.

• Assurer la coordination entre imad et le secteur hospitalier privé/public pour organiser le retour à domicile des clients, avec des prestations fournies par imad.

• Favoriser l’échange d’informations utiles et nécessaires pour la prise en charge du client (selon la documentation prévue).

• Faciliter les sorties d’hôpital des clients et favoriser un retour à domicile dans les meilleures conditions.

• Collaborer avec le client, le proche aidant, les professionnels de la santé et du social.

• Prévenir les (ré)hospitalisations inappropriées.

• Œuvrer en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe de l’arcade imad située aux HUG.

• Bachelor HES-SO en soins infirmiers ou formation jugée équivalente et enregistrée par la Croix-Rouge suisse

• Connaissance du processus de soins et itinéraires cliniques, du réseau santé social genevois

• Aptitude à travailler seul et en interprofessionnalité au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire

• Sens des responsabilités et orientation solution, sens de la communication, de la négociation et de la relation avec autrui

• Capacité d’adaptation et de délégation

• Gestion du stress et des conflits

• Résistance au travail physique.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il campo specifico di collegamento alla cura riguarda i clienti imad (clienti noti o futuri) ricoverati in ospedale, che richiedono un ritorno a casa con servizi imad. Il suo ambito di attività comprende la valutazione delle esigenze, la convalida medica dei servizi richiesti, la previsione del coordinamento degli interventi da parte dei team di assistenza e/o dei servizi centralizzati. Le vostre missioni e responsabilità
• Informare i clienti o i futuri clienti dei servizi residenziali offerti da imad, i partner della rete sanitaria sociale di Ginevra, le tariffe e i termini di rimborso delle prestazioni di assistenza sanitaria. A seconda della necessità, fare riferimento al cliente alla persona o struttura che può consigliare il cliente.
• Assicurare il coordinamento tra imad e il settore ospedaliero privato/pubblico per organizzare il ritorno dei clienti, con servizi forniti da imad.
• Promuovere lo scambio di informazioni utili e necessarie per la cura del cliente (secondo la documentazione fornita).
• Facilitare lo scarico dei clienti dall'ospedale e promuovere un ritorno a casa nelle migliori condizioni.
• Collaborare con clienti, assistenti, operatori sanitari e sociali.
• Prevenire inappropriato (re)ospitalizzazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con la squadra arcade Imad al HUG.
• Bachelor HES-SO in allattamento o formazione considerata equivalente e registrata dalla Croce Rossa svizzera
• Conoscenza del processo di cura e percorsi clinici, la rete sanitaria sociale di Ginevra
• Capacità di lavorare da soli e interprofessionalmente in un team multidisciplinare
• Significato di responsabilità e soluzione di direzione, senso di comunicazione, negoziazione e relazione con gli altri
• Adaptability e delegazione
• Stress e gestione dei conflitti
• Resistenza al lavoro fisico. Cosa offriamo In IMAD, pensiamo che un professionista-il fiore sia un professionista-la performance-e. Ecco perché stiamo facendo tutto il possibile per garantire che si può lavorare tranquillamente ed evolvere in un'offerta di ambiente: Un equilibrio tra privacy e vita lavorativa, con modalità di lavoro flessibili pensate per mantenere il vostro ritmo Retribuzioni vantaggiose e assicurazione sociale, in modo che il vostro impegno è riconosciuto al suo fair value Un campus di formazione IMAD, per continuare a imparare, evolvere e garantire la tua occupabilità nella tua professione Una cultura aziendale basata su valori forti, guidata da una gestione che combina benevolenza e domanda Impegno a un Approccio di responsabilità sociale (SRP) che promuove pratiche sostenibili, umane e inclusive L'Happ Un ambiente professionale ricco, vario e stimolante, più vicino alle realtà umane

descriptionByLocale.en:
The specific field of nursing liaison covers imad clients (known or future clients) hospitalized, requiring a return home with imad services. Its scope of activity includes needs assessment, medical validation of the required services, forecasting of the coordination of interventions by home care teams and/or centralized services. Your missions and responsibilities
• Inform clients or future clients of the residential services offered by imad, the partners of the Geneva social health network, the rates and the terms of reimbursement of home care benefits. Depending on the need, refer the client to the person or structure who can advise the client.
• Ensure coordination between imad and the private/public hospital sector to organize the return of clients, with services provided by imad.
• Promote the exchange of useful and necessary information for the care of the client (according to the documentation provided).
• Facilitate the discharge of clients from hospital and promote a return home in the best conditions.
• Collaborate with clients, caregivers, health and social professionals.
• Prevent inappropriate (re)hospitalization.
• Work closely with the Imad arcade team at the HUG.
• Bachelor HES-SO in nursing or training deemed equivalent and registered by the Swiss Red Cross
• Knowledge of the care process and clinical routes, the Geneva social health network
• Ability to work alone and interprofessionally in a multidisciplinary team
• Meaning of responsibility and direction solution, sense of communication, negotiation and relationship with others
• Adaptability and delegation
• Stress and conflict management
• Resistance to physical work. What We Offer At IMAD, we think that a professional-the flourish is a professional-the performance-e. That's why we're doing everything we can to ensure that you can work calmly and evolve in an environment offering: A balance between privacy and work life, with flexible working arrangements thought to keep your pace Beneficial salaries and social insurance, so that your commitment is recognized at its fair value An IMAD training campus, to continue to learn, evolve and guarantee your employability in your profession A corporate culture based on strong values, driven by a management that combines goodwill and demand Commitment to a Social Responsibility Approach (SRP) that promotes sustainable, humane and inclusive practices The Happ A rich, diverse and stimulating professional environment, closer to human realities
• Deadline for application: 14.06.2026
• Entry into office : 01.08.2026
• Please attach to your file: an updated resume, a cover letter, a copy of your diplomas and your work certificates

In order to avoid a stay in the hospital or to promote an early exit, home hospitalisation (HAD) is intended for anyone, from infant to adult, for whom technical and/or complex hospital-type care is required. Thus, HAD operates throughout the canton 365d/year and 24h/24, when care is deemed possible at home and specific expertise in a specialized field is required (pediatry, adult and paediatric oncology, nephrology, wound care, etc.). The offer of HAD services is part of the relay and complement of the provision of services by the IMAD home maintenance teams. Our nurses provide services independently, respecting the customer's lifestyle, beliefs, values and culture. Interventions are carried out, on medical prescription, in close collaboration with treating or specialized physicians, Proximos, clinics, hospitals and network partners. Your missions and responsibilities
• Respond effectively to specific care by providing autonomously and on medical delegation of technically complex nursing care at home to clients, usually provided in hospital (blood transfusion, peritoneal dialysis, antibiotic IV,...)

• Exercising a role of situational referent and acting in accordance with the principles of the Code of Nursing Ethics to ensure overall care of the client in his or her usual environment

descriptionByLocale.it:
Al fine di evitare un soggiorno in ospedale o di promuovere un'uscita precoce, l'ospedalizzazione domestica (HAD) è destinato a chiunque, da bambino a adulto, per il quale è richiesta una cura tecnica e/o complessa di tipo ospedaliero. Così, HAD opera in tutto il cantone 365d/anno e 24h/24, quando la cura è ritenuta possibile a casa e la competenza specifica in un campo specializzato è richiesto (pediatria, oncologia adulta e pediatrica, nefrologia, cura delle ferite, ecc.). L'offerta dei servizi HAD fa parte del relè e del complemento della fornitura di servizi da parte dei team di manutenzione casa IMAD. I nostri infermieri forniscono servizi indipendentemente, rispettando lo stile di vita del cliente, le convinzioni, i valori e la cultura. Gli interventi vengono effettuati, su prescrizione medica, in stretta collaborazione con medici specializzati, Proximos, cliniche, ospedali e partner di rete. Le vostre missioni e responsabilità
• Rispondere efficacemente a cure specifiche fornendo autonomamente e su delegazione medica di assistenza tecnicamente complessa a casa dei clienti, di solito forniti in ospedale (trasfusione di sangue, dialisi peritoneale, antibiotico IV,...)
• Fornire un'assistenza personalizzata completa ai clienti di tutte le età e ad alto rischio di ricovero, con gravi condizioni (assistenza palliativa per adulti e pediatrica) o condizioni croniche (somatiche e/o psicologiche)
• Esercitare un ruolo di referente situazioniale e agire secondo i principi del Codice Etico Infermieristico per garantire la cura generale del cliente nel suo ambiente abituale
• Partecipare alla missione istituzionale per promuovere la cura della casa in un ambiente stimolante per i nostri clienti.
• Bachelor of Nursing
• Minimo due anni di esperienza lavorativa in ospedale in cura acuta
• Dexterità nell'assistenza tecnica
• Adaptability, flessibilità e reattività
• Grande facilità relazionale, capacità di gestire lo stress e il senso di responsabilità
• Conoscenza della rete di assistenza di Ginevra
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come team interdisciplinare
• Mobilità auto essenziale.
• Termine ultimo per l'applicazione: 31.05.2026
• Entrata in carica: 01.08.2026
• Si prega di allegare al file: un curriculum aggiornato, una lettera di copertura, una copia dei diplomi e il riconoscimento dei diplomi, i certificati di lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to avoid a stay in the hospital or to promote an early exit, home hospitalisation (HAD) is intended for anyone, from infant to adult, for whom technical and/or complex hospital-type care is required. Thus, HAD operates throughout the canton 365d/year and 24h/24, when care is deemed possible at home and specific expertise in a specialized field is required (pediatry, adult and paediatric oncology, nephrology, wound care, etc.). The offer of HAD services is part of the relay and complement of the provision of services by the IMAD home maintenance teams. Our nurses provide services independently, respecting the customer's lifestyle, beliefs, values and culture. Interventions are carried out, on medical prescription, in close collaboration with treating or specialized physicians, Proximos, clinics, hospitals and network partners. Your missions and responsibilities
• Respond effectively to specific care by providing autonomously and on medical delegation of technically complex nursing care at home to clients, usually provided in hospital (blood transfusion, peritoneal dialysis, antibiotic IV,...)
• Provide comprehensive personalized care to clients of all ages and high risk of hospitalization, with severe conditions (adult and paediatric palliative care) or chronic (somatic and/or psychological) conditions
• Exercising a role of situational referent and acting in accordance with the principles of the Code of Nursing Ethics to ensure overall care of the client in his or her usual environment
• Participate in the institutional mission to foster home care in a stimulating environment for our clients.
• Bachelor of Nursing
• Minimum two years of work experience in hospital in acute care
• Dexterity in technical care
• Adaptability, flexibility and responsiveness
• Great relational ease, ability to manage stress and sense of responsibility
• Knowledge of the Geneva care network
• Ability to work independently and as an interdisciplinary team
• Essential car mobility.
• Deadline for application: 31.05.2026
• Entry into office : 01.08.2026
• Please attach to your file: an up-to-date resume, a cover letter, a copy of your diplomas and diploma recognition, your work certificates.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Um einen Aufenthalt im Krankenhaus zu vermeiden oder einen vorzeitigen Ausstieg zu fördern, ist die Heimklinikierung (HAD) für jeden gedacht, von Kleinkind zu Erwachsenen, für die technische und/oder komplexe Krankenhauspflege erforderlich ist. So arbeitet HAD im gesamten Kanton 365d/Jahr und 24h/24, wenn die Pflege zu Hause als möglich gilt und spezielle Expertise in einem spezialisierten Bereich erforderlich ist (Pediatrie, erwachsene und pädiatrische Onkologie, Nephrologie, Wundpflege, etc.). Das Angebot von HAD-Diensten ist Teil des Relais und Ergänzung der Erbringung von Dienstleistungen durch die IMAD-Haushaltsteams. Unsere Krankenschwestern bieten Dienstleistungen unabhängig, die den Lebensstil, die Überzeugungen, Werte und die Kultur des Kunden respektieren. Eingriffe werden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit behandelnden oder spezialisierten Ärzten, Proximos, Kliniken, Krankenhäusern und Netzwerkpartnern durchgeführt. Ihre Missionen und Verantwortlichkeiten
• Beantworten effektiv auf spezifische Pflege durch autonome und medizinische Delegation der technisch komplexen Pflege zu Hause für Kunden, in der Regel im Krankenhaus (Bluttransfusion, Peritonealdialyse, Antibiotika IV,...)
• Bereitstellung einer umfassenden personalisierten Betreuung für Kunden aller Altersgruppen und eines hohen Krankenhausrisikos mit schweren Bedingungen (Erwachsene und pädiatrische palliative Betreuung) oder chronischen (somatischen und/oder psychologischen) Bedingungen
• Ausübung einer Rolle des Sachverwalters und handeln nach den Grundsätzen des Code of Nursing Ethics, um die allgemeine Betreuung des Klienten in seinem oder ihrem gewöhnlichen Umfeld sicherzustellen
• Nehmen Sie an der institutionellen Mission teil, um die Pflege in einer anregenden Umgebung für unsere Kunden zu fördern.
• Bachelor of Nursing
• Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Krankenhaus in der akuten Pflege
• Dexterity in der technischen Betreuung
• Anpassungsfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Reaktionsfähigkeit
• Große relationale Leichtigkeit, Fähigkeit, Stress und Verantwortungsgefühl zu verwalten
• Kenntnisse des Genfer Pflegenetzes
• Fähigkeit, selbständig und als interdisziplinäres Team zu arbeiten
• Grundlegende Mobilität des Autos.

Ainsi, HAD intervient dans tout le canton 365j/année et 24h/24, lorsqu’une prise en charge des soins est jugée possible à domicile et qu’une expertise spécifique dans un domaine spécialisé est requise (pédiatrie, oncologie adulte et pédiatrique, néphrologie, soins de plaies, etc.). L’offre en prestations de HAD s’inscrit en relais et en complémentarité de l’offre en prestations des équipes de maintien à domicile de l'IMAD . Nos infirmiers.ères assurent des prestations de manière autonome, dans le respect des habitudes de vie, des croyances, des valeurs et de la culture du client. Les interventions se font, sur prescription médicale, en étroite collaboration avec les médecins traitants ou spécialisés, Proximos, les cliniques, les hôpitaux et les partenaires du réseau.  Vos missions et responsabilités
• Répondre avec efficacité à des prises en charge spécifiques en dispensant de manière autonome et sur délégation médicale des soins infirmiers techniquement complexes à domicile des clients, habituellement dispensés en milieu hospitalier (transfusion sanguine, dialyse péritonéale, antibiothérapie IV,…)
• Prodiguer des soins personnalisés complets à des clients de tous âges et à haut risque d’hospitalisation, souffrant de pathologies lourdes (soins palliatifs adultes et pédiatrique) ou chronique (somatiques et/ou psychiques)
• Exercer un rôle de référent.e de situation et agir conformément aux principes du code déontologique infirmier afin d’assurer une prise en charge globale du client dans son environnement habituel
• Participer à la mission institutionnelle visant à favoriser le maintien à domicile dans un cadre stimulant pour nos clients.
• Bachelor en soins infirmiers
• Minimum deux ans d’expérience professionnelle en milieu hospitalier au sein d’un service de soins aigus
• Dextérité dans les soins techniques
• Capacité d’adaptation, de souplesse et de réactivité
• Grande aisance relationnelle, aptitude à gérer le stress et sens des responsabilités
• Connaissance du réseau de soins genevois
• Aptitude au travail en autonomie ainsi qu’en équipe interdisciplinaire
• Mobilité en voiture indispensable.
